  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  FEBRUARY 11, 2020

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 4:30 p.m.,
  on Tuesday, February 11, 2020, at Civic Center- East Wing, 1855 Main Street.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day (Arrived at 4:32 p.m.)
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Greg Morena
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  Assistant City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:30 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem O’Day.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

  Mayor Pro Tem O’Day  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:32 p.m., to consider
  arrived at 4:32 p.m.  closed sessions and returned at 5:35 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  1.A.  Public Employee Evaluation
  Title: City Attorney

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:35 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Kevin McKeown
  Assistant City Clerk  Mayor

  1  February 11, 2020
